mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over two consecutive quarters signals a tightening monetary regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of quarters when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of quarters with YoY GDPC1 decline exceeding 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market that boosts wage inflation and input costs, compressing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE above 0.5 percentage points within the same month indicates a mismatch between job creation and labor force growth, which reduces per-worker productivity and signals negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases by >0.5pp in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls by more than 0.5pp simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 0.5% for four consecutive months signals accelerating industrial production, which typically coincides with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 records negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises above 0.5% for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST for two consecutive months signals deteriorating housing and overall demand, which increases recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of episodes where both GDPC1 and HOUST fall for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in CPIAUCSL below 1% for six consecutive months signals a prolonged period of low inflation, which typically coincides with accommodative monetary policy and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL remains below 1% for six consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE of at least 0.3 percentage points within the same month signals labor market softening, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases by >=0.3pp in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls by at least 0.3pp simultaneously.
